# Two-ink print — Style Prompt

> A film that looks printed on a stencil duplicator: two or three translucent spot inks overprinted on warm paper, halftone dots at their own screen angles, plates that never quite line up, ink that arrives with a roller sweep, and a small figure in a big flat world under a single round sun.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A two-ink print prints **one colour at a time**: every colour is its own plate with its own translucent ink. That one fact makes the look.

- **A tiny palette**: three spot inks (blue, yellow, pink) on warm off-white paper; every other colour is an overprint (blue + yellow = green, yellow + pink = orange, blue + pink = purple) or a tint.
- **Misregistration**: each plate lands a few pixels off. A fixed offset per plate (about 2-3 px), never jittered every frame.
- **Halftone dots** for mid-tones, each plate on its own screen angle (blue 15°, yellow 0°, pink 75°), period about 9 px at 1920 wide.
- **Flat shapes, no outlines**: forms are colour fields and silhouettes; one horizon, one big disc, one small figure.
- **Prints do not fade**: ink arrives with a roller wipe (a clip edge moving left to right) or on a beat, and leaves on a cut.

It is not flat vector art with a noise overlay (every colour comes from a plate), not CMYK pop-art halftone (no process colours, no keyline), and not an opaque screen-print poster (the ink is translucent). Never show a two-ink print brand, logo or machine.

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Plates as layers.** Each ink is a full-frame layer with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` over the paper, so overprint is real multiplication, not a drawn mixture. Draw a plate's shapes in one ink only; build a mixed colour by putting the same shape on two plates.
- **Halftone** is an SVG `<pattern>` of round dots rotated to the plate's screen angle, in three coverages (25 / 50 / 75 %); a solid is the ink at full strength. Use stepped bands (25 / 50 / 75 / 100) for skies and distance, never a smooth gradient.
- **Knockout.** A paper-coloured shape drawn (normal blend) between two plates blanks the plates beneath it: the pale halo that stops the world's ink from showing through the figure, or the round hole that makes the sun pure pink.
- **Paper grain** is drawn once from a seeded PRNG into a small canvas (dark flecks, pale pinholes, faint vertical feed streaks), turned into an image and laid over everything with multiply; it drifts in coarse steps, so it boils slowly without a per-frame redraw.
- **Misregistration** uses the CSS `translate` and `rotate` properties on each plate (fixed), so the tweens (`x`, kicks, drift) never fight it.
- Every area uses at most two plates, one of them a tint; three halftones stacked turn to mud. Design for the one-plate version: the first plate alone must already read as a complete composition.
- Avoid live 3D and shaders (this recipe is the 2D rebuild of a shader original), blur and animated halftone fills. Move transforms and clip edges only.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--utama` is the **pink plate** and `--aksen` is the **yellow plate**: the brand's two colours become two inks, and their overprint (a third colour) comes for free. With a pale brand the inks are pale, so keep type and key shapes on the blue plate.
- **Fixed, not brand**: the paper (`--kertas`, warm off-white), the blue ink (`--tinta-biru`) and the printed-text colour (`--cetak`, blue pulled toward ink-black). Multiply needs a light sheet, so the paper does not follow a dark brand; the whole film is one sheet.
- Printed type is the blue plate with a pink double-hit; text on a knockout strip is `--cetak` on `--kertas`. `--teks` and the other contract tokens are declared for the brand but the printed world does not draw with them.
- Save the full three-plate overprint (sky, skyline, disc together) for the ending that earns it.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (Archivo Black): heavy grotesque for printed titles, 190-270 px at 1920 wide for a headline word, 96 px for a long title; one or two short lines, never a sentence. The second hit sits 8 px right and 6 px down in the pink ink, behind the blue.
- `--font-isi` (Poppins 800 for captions, 500 if needed): 44-50 px, on a paper knockout strip (radius 6) or on blank paper.
- Type is printed: it arrives with a roller wipe or a plate kick and never fades.

## 5. Motion quality

- A plate arrives as a clip wipe from left to right: 0.5-1.1 s, `power1.inOut`. A plate lands with a kick of 10-12 px that decays in about 0.34 s with slight ringing (`elastic.out(1, 0.3)`).
- A held moment may drift one plate about 22 px over 0.9 s, linear, then snap back in one frame on the downbeat.
- Characters move on twos: a walking figure bobs 9 px in `steps(2)` at 0.25 s; the camera never moves except a slow push (scale 1 to 2.3 over 2.7 s) into a halftone field.
- The disc turns slowly (one turn per film); the paper grain drifts 50 px in 90 coarse steps.
- Scene changes are cuts hidden under an overprint: a pink disc grows 0.6 s (`power2.in`) until it covers the frame, the scene swaps beneath it, it shrinks 0.8 s (`power2.out`). Never a cross-dissolve.
- Endings hold at least 2 s with only the grain moving.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | Expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Static wide, small figure crosses the frame | Routine, scale, arrival | an opening; a commute; a delivery |
| Locked composition: horizon, disc, figure | Stillness, a decision | the ending; a title; a calm statement |
| Straight-on wall of flat squares | Abundance, pattern | a catalogue; a backlog; a collection |
| Push into a halftone field until dots become shapes | Entering the print | one big number; a crowd; a memory |
| Overprint transition (disc grows, shrinks) | A change of place or time | between chapters; before and after |
| Pull back to the whole sheet | It was one print | a summing-up; a series; a credit |

## 7. Native moves

- **Plates as narrative.** The world gains one ink at each turning point: yellow first, blue next, pink last. *Fits content like:* a neighbourhood event announcing itself; a recipe adding ingredients; a story gaining a character.
- **Overprint third colour.** Two inks cross and the overlap is a new colour. *Fits content like:* two bands sharing a bill; a class that merges two skills; a collaboration between two shops.
- **The disc transition.** One round pink shape grows over the frame and shrinks into the next scene's sun. *Fits content like:* a record, a coin, a plate of food becoming a clock; a chapter break in a zine.
- **Halftone push-in.** Dots swell into shapes while the number beside them stays still. *Fits content like:* attendance for a sale; rainfall for a farm; followers for a creator.
- **Registration as feeling.** A kick on every landing, a slow drift in a held moment, a snap on the beat. *Fits content like:* nerves before a speech; a countdown; a memory coming into focus.
- **Knockout strip.** Contact and captions on a paper-white strip with a small radius, so the text always reads. *Fits content like:* an address; a class schedule; a shop's opening hours.

## 8. Pitfalls

- Three halftone plates in one area read as mud: two plates, one tint.
- A mixed colour built on fewer plates than its parts floats loose in the one-ink version: start from the first plate.
- Jittering offsets every frame flickers: one offset per plate, kicks only on accents.
- A blurred or gradient fill kills the print: stay with solid ink and stepped halftone.
- Dark brands: the sheet stays paper, so the inks must still be visible on it; keep type on the blue plate.
- Do not stack many pattern-filled elements that all move: animate the plate's clip edge or the small figure only.

# Two-ink print: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.6, medium 2.6, long 3.4.

## hook

- en: yellow is on the paper; blue then pink sweep in on a roller edge, a small figure crosses the street, the pink disc rises as sun
- id: kuning sudah di kertas; biru lalu pink menyapu masuk dengan tepi rol, tokoh kecil melintasi jalan lebar, piringan pink naik jadi matahari

## problem

- en: a wall of flat colour squares prints plate by plate, each an overprint of two inks; the headline sweeps on in blue with a pink double-hit
- id: tembok kotak warna datar tercetak pelat demi pelat, tiap kotak tumpukan dua tinta; judul menyapu masuk biru dengan bayangan pink

## fact

- en: one shape in one ink is printed alone on blank paper with a knockout strip label; a second ink overprints it into a third colour
- id: satu bentuk satu tinta dicetak sendirian di kertas kosong dengan label di strip kertas; tinta kedua menumpuk jadi warna ketiga

## step

- en: one plate per step: each step adds an ink to the same drawing, plates landing with a small kick and settling misregistered
- id: satu pelat tiap langkah: tiap langkah menambah tinta ke gambar yang sama, pelat mendarat dengan sentakan kecil lalu meleset tipis

## compare

- en: two inks in dialogue, one per half; where they meet the overprint makes the third colour, the overlap is the finding
- id: dua tinta berdialog, satu tiap sisi; di tempat bertemu tumpukannya jadi warna ketiga, irisan itulah temuannya

## number

- en: the figure printed huge in blue with a pink double-hit beside a halftone sun; a push-in swells the dots, the pink plate drifts then snaps
- id: angka dicetak besar biru berbayang pink di samping matahari raster; dorong masuk membesarkan titik, pelat pink melenceng lalu menjepret

## proof

- en: a column of quiet sheets: knockout strips with a name and a line each, inks locked, the paper grain the only thing moving
- id: deretan lembar tenang: strip kertas berisi nama dan satu baris, tinta terkunci, hanya butir kertas yang bergerak

## offer

- en: the full overprint lands: all three plates over the skyline, the disc grows from nothing to its place, the offer on a knockout strip
- id: overprint penuh mendarat: tiga pelat di atas kota, piringan tumbuh dari nol ke tempatnya, penawaran di strip kertas

## cta

- en: the sunset print locked, title double-hit in the sky, contact on paper strips, the disc turning slowly; held 2 s
- id: cetakan senja terkunci, judul berbayang di langit, kontak di strip kertas, piringan berputar pelan; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: pull back to the whole sheet as plates lift away one by one until the last line stands in a single ink; held 2 s
- id: mundur ke seluruh lembar saat pelat terangkat satu per satu sampai kalimat terakhir berdiri dalam satu tinta; diam 2 detik

<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Cetak cetak dua tinta</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Poppins"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f4eee2; --latar-2: #fbf7ee; --utama: #ff48b0; --aksen: #ffe800;
        --teks: #17306b; --teks-redup: #4b5f93; --teks-di-utama: #1b1530; --teks-di-aksen: #1b1530;
        --utama-di-latar: #d4207f; --aksen-di-latar: #a87400;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Poppins", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Cetakan: kertas dan tinta biru tetap; tinta pink dan kuning mengikuti brand. */
        --kertas: #f4eee2; --tinta-biru: #0078bf; --tinta-pink: var(--utama); --tinta-kuning: var(--aksen);
        --cetak: color-mix(in oklab, var(--tinta-biru) 66%, #12142f);
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--kertas);}
      #root {position:relative;width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--kertas);isolation:isolate;font-family:var(--font-isi);}
      .sc, .pls, .pl, #disc {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;}
      .sc {background:var(--kertas);isolation:isolate;}
      .pl {mix-blend-mode:multiply;overflow:visible;opacity:0.92;}
      .hl {mix-blend-mode:normal;opacity:1;}
      /* Pelat meleset: tiap tinta mendarat beberapa piksel dari tempatnya (translate terpisah dari tween). */
      .pl.y {translate:3px -2px;} .pl.p {translate:-3px 3px;rotate:0.08deg;} .pl.b {translate:0 0;}
      /* Tinta penuh dan raster titik; sudut layar 15 / 0 / 75 derajat. */
      .y1 {fill:var(--tinta-kuning);} .b1 {fill:var(--tinta-biru);} .p1 {fill:var(--tinta-pink);}
      .y25 {fill:url(#py25);} .y50 {fill:url(#py50);} .y75 {fill:url(#py75);}
      .b25 {fill:url(#pb25);} .b50 {fill:url(#pb50);} .b75 {fill:url(#pb75);}
      .p25 {fill:url(#pp25);} .p50 {fill:url(#pp50);} .p75 {fill:url(#pp75);}
      .h {fill:var(--kertas);stroke:var(--kertas);stroke-width:12;stroke-linejoin:round;}
      #disc {mix-blend-mode:multiply;} #disc * {mix-blend-mode:multiply;}
      .kd {position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:var(--kertas);width:540px;height:540px;}
      /* Huruf dicetak: tinta biru, dengan tinta pink sedikit meleset di bawahnya (double hit). */
      .t {position:absolute;font-family:var(--font-judul);color:var(--cetak);mix-blend-mode:multiply;line-height:1;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:8px 6px 0 var(--tinta-pink);}
      /* Stiker cetak: tinta penuh, tepi kertas putih, sedikit miring. */
      .k {position:absolute;background:var(--utama);color:var(--teks-di-utama);padding:8px 30px 10px;border-radius:40px;rotate:-2deg;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px var(--kertas);font:800 44px/1.1 var(--font-isi);white-space:nowrap;}
      .k2 {background:var(--aksen);color:var(--teks-di-aksen);rotate:1.5deg;}
      .ln {fill:none;stroke:var(--tinta-biru);stroke-width:8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;} .sp {stroke-width:3;} .wh {transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 50%;}
      .h2 {fill:none;stroke:var(--kertas);stroke-width:22;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
      .n {position:absolute;font:800 50px/1.2 var(--font-isi);color:var(--cetak);mix-blend-mode:multiply;white-space:nowrap;}
      .cl {clip-path:inset(0 0 0 1000px);}
      .mot {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;}
      .grain {position:absolute;left:-20px;top:-12px;width:1960px;height:1104px;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:0.6;}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <!-- Raster titik per tinta (biru 15°, kuning 0°, pink 75°), dipakai lewat kelas. -->
    <svg width="0" height="0" style="position: absolute"><defs id="df"></defs></svg>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <!-- Hook: tinta kuning sudah di kertas, biru dan pink menyusul; piringan pink jadi matahari. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <div class="pls"></div>
        <div class="t x1" style="left: 110px; top: 110px; font-size: 200px">MALAM</div>
        <div class="t x1" style="left: 110px; top: 320px; font-size: 200px">DENGAR</div>
        <div class="k x1" style="left: 110px; top: 545px">Lapak Piringan Senja</div>
      </div>
      <!-- Problem: tembok sampul piringan, dicetak pelat demi pelat. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s2" data-role="problem">
        <div class="pls"></div>
        <div class="t x2" style="left: 100px; top: 150px; font-size: 190px">RAK</div>
        <div class="t x2" style="left: 100px; top: 350px; font-size: 190px">PENUH.</div>
        <div class="k x2" style="left: 100px; top: 700px">Kursi cuma dua belas.</div>
        <div class="k x2" style="left: 100px; top: 790px">Sisanya berdiri.</div>
      </div>
      <!-- Number: jam acara, titik raster membesar jadi bentuk. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s3" data-role="number">
        <div class="pls"></div>
        <div class="t x3" style="left: 100px; top: 250px; font-size: 270px">19.00</div>
        <div class="k x3" style="left: 100px; top: 620px">Sabtu, 8 November</div>
        <div class="k x3" style="left: 100px; top: 710px">Gratis. Bawa telinga.</div>
      </div>
      <!-- CTA: overprint penuh, matahari piringan di atas atap, kontak di kertas. Diam sejak 12,5 detik. -->
      <div class="sc" id="s4" data-role="cta">
        <div class="pls"></div>
        <div class="t x4" style="left: 100px; top: 80px; font-size: 96px">LAPAK PIRINGAN</div>
        <div class="t x4" style="left: 100px; top: 185px; font-size: 96px">SENJA</div>
        <div class="k x4" style="left: 100px; top: 330px">Malam Dengar · 8 Nov · 19.00</div>
        <div class="k k2 x4" style="left: 100px; top: 420px; font-size: 38px">Jl. Cemara 4 · Chat 0812-3456-7890</div>
      </div>
      <!-- Piringan pink: satu bentuk yang tumbuh menutupi layar lalu menyusut jadi matahari adegan berikutnya. -->
      <svg id="disc" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">
        <g id="dg"><g id="sp">
          <circle cx="1380" cy="380" r="270" class="p1" />
          <g id="rg" style="fill: none; stroke: var(--tinta-biru); stroke-width: 3; opacity: 0.55"></g>
          <path d="M1380 200 A180 180 0 0 1 1560 380" fill="none" style="stroke: var(--kertas); stroke-width: 16; opacity: 0.45" />
          <circle cx="1380" cy="380" r="78" class="y1" /><circle cx="1380" cy="380" r="12" class="b1" />
        </g></g>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const $ = (s, r = document) => r.querySelector(s);
      // PRNG berbenih: tidak ada Math.random.
      const mulberry = (a) => () => {
        a = (a + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
        let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
        t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
      const rnd = mulberry(1953);
      const R = (x, y, w, h, c) => `<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" class="${c}"/>`;
      const C = (x, y, r, c) => `<circle cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="${r}" class="${c}"/>`;
      const P = (d, c) => `<path d="${d}" class="${c}"/>`;

      // Raster: pola titik per tinta dan kerapatan (luas titik = 25 / 50 / 75 persen).
      function rasters() {
        const ang = { b: 15, y: 0, p: 75 };
        let s = "";
        for (const k of "byp") {
          for (const [n, r] of [[25, 2.5], [50, 3.6], [75, 4.4]]) {
            s += `<pattern id="p${k}${n}" width="9" height="9" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="rotate(${ang[k]})"><circle cx="4.5" cy="4.5" r="${r}" class="${k}1"/></pattern>`;
          }
        }
        $("#df").innerHTML = s;
        $("#rg").innerHTML = [60, 100, 140, 180, 220, 250].map((r) => `<circle cx="1380" cy="380" r="${r}"/>`).join("");
      }

      // Atap kota sebagai blok acak berbenih di garis cakrawala (y 650).
      function atap(c) {
        let s = "";
        for (let x = -20; x < 1940; ) {
          const w = 70 + rnd() * 70, h = 40 + rnd() * 80;
          s += R(x, 650 - h, w, h + 4, c);
          x += w + 4;
        }
        return s + R(430, 470, 26, 190, c) + R(1010, 500, 22, 160, c);
      }

      // Dunia datar: langit berundak (kuning, di senja ditambah pink), atap biru, rumput hijau = biru + kuning.
      function dunia(sc, senja, tanpaMatahari) {
        const sky = R(0, 0, 1920, 230, "y25") + R(0, 230, 1920, 110, "y50") + R(0, 340, 1920, 90, "y75") + R(0, 430, 1920, 130, "y1");
        const yel = sky + R(0, 650, 1920, 255, "y1");
        let pink = senja ? R(0, 200, 1920, 140, "p25") + R(0, 340, 1920, 90, "p50") + R(0, 430, 1920, 130, "p75") : "";
        let blu = atap(senja ? "b75" : "b50") + R(0, 650, 1920, 255, senja ? "b75" : "b25") + R(0, 975, 1920, 105, "b1") + (tanpaMatahari ? "" : R(640, 430, 10, 480, "b1") + R(612, 420, 62, 16, "b1"));
        const kb = !senja && !tanpaMatahari ? kebun() : null;
        if (kb) blu += kb.b;
        const w = (k, inner) => sc.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<svg class="pl w ${k}" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">${inner}</svg>`);
        w("y", yel);
        if (pink) w("p", pink);
        const cx = senja ? 1300 : 1380, cy = senja ? 390 : 380;
        if (!tanpaMatahari) sc.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<div class="kd" style="left:${cx - 270}px;top:${cy - 270}px"></div>`);
        w("b", blu);
        // Pohon: kertas kosong di bawah mahkota, lalu pink murni, lalu bintik dan batang biru.
        if (kb) {
          sc.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend", `<svg class="pl hl" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080">${kb.c}</svg>`);
          w("p", kb.p);
          w("b", kb.t);
        }
      }

      // Pemilik toko bersepeda, peti piringan di keranjang; roda di (+-95, -62). Bagian: [tinta, kelas, bentuk].
      const cincin = (cx) => `M${cx - 62} -62a62 62 0 1 0 124 0a62 62 0 1 0 -124 0`;
      const jari = (cx) => [0, 60, 120].map((a) => `M${cx - 58 * Math.cos((a * Math.PI) / 180)} ${-62 - 58 * Math.sin((a * Math.PI) / 180)}L${cx + 58 * Math.cos((a * Math.PI) / 180)} ${-62 + 58 * Math.sin((a * Math.PI) / 180)}`).join("");
      const KAKI = "M-48 -168L-20 -178L30 -112L12 -98ZM14 -118L42 -102L-2 -58L-20 -72Z";
      const BADAN = "M-64 -172L-30 -186L42 -282L76 -262L8 -160ZM50 -268L100 -216L96 -196L40 -240Z";
      const FIG = [
        ["b", "ln", cincin(-95) + cincin(95)], ["b", "ln sp wh", jari(-95)], ["b", "ln sp wh", jari(95)],
        ["b", "ln", "M-95 -62L-30 -150L48 -150L95 -62M-30 -150L-8 -62L48 -150M48 -150L58 -190L90 -194"],
        ["y", "y1", KAKI], ["b", "b75", KAKI], ["b", "b1", "M-62 -160h46v12h-46ZM-26 -70h36v12h-36ZM32 -322Q34 -358 66 -354Q94 -350 92 -320Q78 -338 32 -322Z"],
        ["p", "p1", BADAN], ["b", "b50", BADAN],
        ["y", "y25", "M62 -318m-30 0a30 30 0 1 0 60 0a30 30 0 1 0 -60 0M90 -316l12 9l-12 3Z"],
        ["b", "ln sp", "M70 -322a9 9 0 1 0 18 0a9 9 0 1 0 -18 0M74 -298q8 5 16 0"], ["p", "p50", "M70 -304m-8 0a8 8 0 1 0 16 0a8 8 0 1 0 -16 0"],
        ["p", "p1", "M30 -286L74 -282L70 -264L28 -268ZM32 -280Q-20 -300 -70 -270L-78 -250Q-30 -268 28 -262ZM108 -246h18v34h-18ZM148 -246h18v34h-18Z"],
        ["b", "b1", "M92 -214h112v8h-112ZM128 -240h18v28h-18ZM168 -242h18v30h-18Z"], ["y", "y1", "M96 -214h104v62h-104Z"],
      ];
      function tokoh(sc, x, y) {
        const g = (c) => `<g class="fg" transform="translate(${x} ${y}) scale(1.05)"><g class="bob">${c}</g></g>`;
